_doc: Bonds (design/people/people-and-side-activities-spec.md §4-5; build item N-7.6.1). Each person you know has a lamp (0 to full) and a tier. tiers: in order, each with its name, the lamp it starts at (from) and whether crossing into it needs a scene (scene: the story's `bond_cross <who>` effect, which works only with the lamp full for the tier below); a tier without a scene is reached by the lamp alone. Points stop at the top of the current tier until its crossing scene plays; a loss falls at most to the bottom of the current tier; only betrayal drops a tier. caps: the highest tier by people.json kind (role people have no track: -1). sources: what gains bond: gain (lamp points; story gains give their own), per (key: once per key a life; week: once a week per person; life: once a life), fill: true sets the lamp to the next tier's start (a first talk makes you Warm). gifts: the gain by the person's taste for the item (people.json tastes: love, like, dislike, cant_bear, each a list of item ids or gift kinds; anything else is plain); a gift is once a week per person and its reaction is learned for every later life (Run.soul tastes). floors: the tier the next life starts at, by the best tier reached in any life (Close or Kindred: Warm; Sworn: Friendly).
